name: marketplace-entitlement
description: AWS Marketplace Entitlement Service This reference provides descriptions of the AWS Marketplace Entitlement Service API.

subcommands.name: get-entitlements
subcommands.description: GetEntitlements retrieves entitlement values for a given product.

options.name: --product-code
options.description: Product code is used to uniquely identify a product in AWS Marketplace.

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter is used to return entitlements for a specific customer or for a specific dimension.

options.name: --next-token
options.description: For paginated calls to GetEntitlements, pass the NextToken from the previous GetEntitlementsResult

options.name: --max-results
options.description: The maximum number of items to retrieve from the GetEntitlements operation.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --starting-token
options.description: A token to specify where to start paginating.

options.name: --page-size
options.description: The size of each page to get in the AWS service call.

options.name: --max-items
options.description: The total number of items to return in the command's output.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
